_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from cited Brazilian court and prosecutor records. Convictions and reported roles are tied to the cited source dates; a reported death is not a legal finding. Public senior figures only, with country-level associations. No operational route information or photos are included.

sources.title: Caso Belarmino: Justiça condena a 44 anos de prisão mandante do assassinato contra agente penitenciário no Paraná
sources.claim: The federal prosecutor identifies Primeiro Comando da Capital by its PCC abbreviation as a Brazilian criminal organization and describes a former leader's conviction.

people.name: Marcos Willians Herbas Camacho
people.roleLabel: PCC leader; convicted in the murder of a judge

sources.title: TJSP mantém condenação de Marcos Camacho pela morte de juiz de Presidente Prudente
sources.publisher: Tribunal de Justiça do Estado de São Paulo
sources.claim: The São Paulo court reports that it upheld Camacho's 29-year conviction for the murder of judge Antonio José Machado Dias and identifies his alias Marcola and PCC leadership context.

sources.title: STF rejeita pedido para reduzir pena de integrante da cúpula do PCC
sources.claim: The Supreme Court identifies Marcola as a PCC leader when describing Fuminho's connection to him.

people.name: Júlio César Guedes de Moraes
people.roleLabel: Former PCC leader; convicted in the murder of a judge

sources.title: Autor intelectual de homicídio de magistrado tem recurso negado
sources.publisher: Tribunal de Justiça do Estado de São Paulo
sources.claim: The São Paulo court reports that Moraes, known as Julinho Carambola, lost an appeal of his 29-year murder conviction and describes him as a leader of a criminal organization.

sources.title: TJSP confirma decisão que manda a júri acusados de matar bombeiro
sources.publisher: Tribunal de Justiça do Estado de São Paulo
sources.claim: The court identifies Moraes and Marcola as PCC leaders charged together in a separate case; this source does not establish a conviction in that case.

people.name: Gilberto Aparecido dos Santos
people.roleLabel: PCC senior figure; convicted at first instance for drug offenses

sources.title: STF rejeita pedido para reduzir pena de integrante da cúpula do PCC
sources.claim: The Supreme Court reports Fuminho's first-instance conviction for drug trafficking and related offenses, and describes him as reportedly Marcola's right-hand man.

sources.title: Justiça recebe denúncia contra acusados de participar da morte de Paca e Gegê do Mangue
sources.publisher: Tribunal de Justiça do Estado do Ceará
sources.claim: The Ceará court gives Fuminho's fuller name as Gilberto Aparecido dos Santos and reports a homicide charge; this is an allegation, not a conviction in that case.

people.name: Roberto Soriano
people.roleLabel: Former PCC leader; convicted in the Belarmino murder case

sources.title: Caso Belarmino: Justiça condena a 44 anos de prisão mandante do assassinato contra agente penitenciário no Paraná
sources.claim: Federal prosecutors report Soriano, described as a former PCC leader, was convicted and sentenced to 44 years and eight months for ordering an agent's murder and for participation in a criminal organization.

sources.title: Justiça recebe denúncia contra acusados de participar da morte de Paca e Gegê do Mangue
sources.publisher: Tribunal de Justiça do Estado do Ceará
sources.claim: The Ceará court identifies de Simone, alias Gegê do Mangue, as a PCC leader and reports his death alongside Fabiano Alves de Souza.

sources.title: Justiça recebe denúncia contra acusados de participar da morte de Paca e Gegê do Mangue
sources.publisher: Tribunal de Justiça do Estado do Ceará
sources.claim: The Ceará court identifies de Souza, alias Paca, as a PCC leader and reports his death alongside Rogério Jeremias de Simone.

connections.label: Fuminho described as Marcola's right-hand man

sources.title: STF rejeita pedido para reduzir pena de integrante da cúpula do PCC
sources.claim: The Supreme Court describes Fuminho as reportedly the right-hand man of Marcola; the qualifier is retained because the relationship is attributed, not judicially proved.

connections.label: Both identified by the São Paulo court as PCC leaders

sources.title: TJSP confirma decisão que manda a júri acusados de matar bombeiro
sources.publisher: Tribunal de Justiça do Estado de São Paulo
sources.claim: The court names Marcola and Julinho Carambola together as PCC leaders among those charged in the case; it does not report a conviction in that case.

connections.label: Both identified as PCC leaders and victims in the same case
